name: Douglas M. Smith
bottom_line: A detailed incumbent biography that checks out on the record. Some figures are leftovers from 2022.
findings: His 2018 special election, Education Committee ranking role and 67% in 2022 are all confirmed.
The "48% of New Yorkers and 60% of Long Islanders voted for a new direction" line refers to the 2022 governor's race and was never updated.
